reason_detail: A 25000 NGN transfer failed twice and the debit was never reversed.
summary: Customer left after a failed transfer that debited him without a reversal. Accepted a priority reversal ticket and agreed to return once resolved.

reason_detail: A 1075 NGN fee on a 20000 NGN transfer felt excessive and unexplained.
summary: Customer was upset by an unexplained transfer fee. Accepted a three-transaction fee waiver and agreed to return.
recommended_product_fix: Show a fee breakdown before confirming transfers.

reason_detail: Card declined three times at POS and no support response for days.
summary: Customer is frustrated by repeated card declines and slow support. Declined the callback offer for now; open follow-up remains.
recommended_product_fix: Add proactive card-status alerts and faster POS-decline diagnostics.

reason_detail: Customer reports an unauthorised 40000 NGN debit after sharing a code with a scam caller.
fraud_detail: Unauthorised 40000 NGN debit after sharing a code with a scam caller.
summary: Customer lost money to what looks like social-engineering fraud and froze the account. Escalated to the fraud team with urgent callback.
recommended_product_fix: Add in-app fraud alerts and a one-tap account freeze.

reason_detail: A 90000 NGN transfer failed and the beneficiary never received the funds.
summary: Customer's large transfer failed outright. Accepted a priority retry/reversal ticket and agreed to return once resolved.
recommended_product_fix: Add automatic transfer retries with status notifications.

reason_detail: Unexplained SMS and stamp-duty charges eroded trust in pricing.
summary: Customer wants a clear explanation of recurring small charges before considering returning. Waiver declined for now; follow-up scheduled.
recommended_product_fix: Publish a plain-language fee schedule in-app.

reason_detail: Account restricted pending BVN update; customer cannot withdraw funds.
summary: Customer is willing to return and needs the BVN restriction lifted. Sent a reactivation link (mock SMS) with next steps.
recommended_product_fix: Add in-app BVN re-verification with instant status updates.

reason_detail: Customer reports unauthorised transfer attempts that locked the account.
fraud_detail: Unauthorised transfer attempts observed before account lock.
summary: Customer's account was locked after unauthorised transfer attempts. Escalated to the fraud team with urgent callback.
recommended_product_fix: Add in-app fraud alerts and a one-tap account freeze.

reason_detail: A 30000 NGN transfer failed once and the customer gave up on the app.
summary: Customer is noncommittal about returning after a single failed transfer. Ticket offer declined; follow-up scheduled.
recommended_product_fix: Add automatic transfer retries with status notifications.

reason_detail: Tier limit blocked after incomplete KYC upgrade.
summary: Customer just needs to finish the KYC upgrade. Sent a reactivation link (mock SMS) and he agreed to complete it.
recommended_product_fix: Send reminders when a KYC upgrade is left incomplete.

reason_detail: Virtual card declined for online subscription payments.
summary: Customer is blocked from online payments by virtual card declines. Callback offered but not yet accepted; follow-up remains open.
recommended_product_fix: Improve virtual card merchant-compatibility and add decline reasons.

reason_detail: Multiple transfer fees in one month totalled 4300 NGN.
summary: Customer switched to a competitor over cumulative fees and is not returning. Waiver declined; no follow-up wanted.
recommended_product_fix: Introduce a monthly fee cap for high-frequency users.

reason_detail: Card declined at ATM withdrawal twice, resolved by reissue.
summary: Customer's ATM issue was explained and a card reissue scheduled via callback. Agreed to stay.
recommended_product_fix: Notify customers when their card is due for reissue.

reason_detail: A 150000 NGN rent transfer failed and was debited without reversal.
summary: Customer's rent transfer failed and was debited. Accepted a priority reversal ticket and agreed to return once refunded.

reason_detail: Card maintenance fee charged on an inactive account felt unfair.
summary: Customer accepted a fee waiver for unfair maintenance charges and agreed to resume using the app.
recommended_product_fix: Waive maintenance fees for accounts inactive over 30 days.
